sweeps.rationale: This strip is rendered above the model's native size because hires-fix only matters when a one-pass render is being asked to go larger than the model handles comfortably. A person makes the failure easy to see: repeated knowledge becomes a second head or extra limb, not just vague softness. The tall frame is intentional because SD1.5 often stacks a subject through a long image instead of enlarging one clean subject. The default SD1.5 model is used because the photoreal model holds together well enough to hide the lesson.

stops.caption: Canny makes a clean outline map of the visible edges: railing wires, mast fittings, coat folds, and the line of the hills. The final image follows those shapes closely, but it still chooses its own colour and small details, so the coat turns brown and the goggles become spectacles.

hed draws softer, thicker strokes and lets the small detail go, so the railing survives as a few bars and the face is barely described. The image keeps the pose and the horizon and takes the rest for itself: a warmer sky, a tan coat, teal in the hair.

pidinet keeps the heavy boundaries and empties out the interior, leaving the head, the coat and the railing as flat shapes. The image fills those shapes with a picture of its own, and the airship envelope comes back as a pale sail.

teed finds fine line everywhere, including the edges of the clouds and the panels of the envelope. The image follows it closely and reads as a pen drawing with colour washed over it, with the envelope drawn as a ribbed gold balloon.

pyracanny gives the same complete outline as canny with a softer edge to it. The image keeps the whole scene, down to the wires of the railing and the curve of the deck, and uses its freedom on colour.

binary reduces the photograph to black and white with no grey between, so the coat becomes one mass and the face is lost. The image contains a face to fill the gap and reads the speckle under the railing as boats on water.
scribble reduces the picture to a few coarse strokes. The image keeps the standing figure and the railing, closes the eyes it had to invent, and turns the envelope into a plain white shape.

fakescribbles traces the main shapes in thick rounded strokes and puts nothing inside them. The pose and the deck stay in the same positions, the railing comes back as wire mesh, and the goggles become an earpiece against the hair.
